Resonance Hum.name: Resonance Hum
Resonance Hum.description: The user fixes on one object within a room's width, finds its natural pitch with a quiet sweep, and holds a vibrating hum that shakes that object alone. In moments it shatters a pane of glass, a visor or a brittle lock, or rattles the bolts and pins loose on a door hinge, a shackle or a weapon casing while leaving people beside it unharmed. Holding pitch and tremor dulls the user's hearing until their next turn. Strain: moderate.
